youtube.baslik: What do you get when you add 60 dB and 60 dB? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Two equal 60 dB sound sources together give about 63 dB, not 120. Loudness is also compressed: a 10 dB increase means ten times the intensity, yet the sound seems only about twice as loud.

instagram.kanca: What is sixty decibels plus sixty decibels?
bilgiler: Two equal 60 dB sounds together give about 63 dB, not 120.
Decibels do not simply add up.
A 10 dB increase is ten times the intensity, but only about twice as loud.
